messages:
Anya: heads-up — nightly perf suite shows regression after AWQ weight-only group_size bump to 64. KV-cache-heavy traces (seq_len 8, batch 16) see ~12% p50 increase.
Cheng: can you paste the perf.sh command + config?
Anya: perf run command: `./bench_kv --model llama-70b-awq --group-size=64 --seq=8 --batch=16 --kv-cache=true`
Mike: saw the CI alert too. quick probe: `nvprof` trace shows extra memcpy and ~200 more kernel launches per request.
Marisol: pinged the runtime profiler — initial flame shows `pack_weights` time up 2.3ms, `kv_cache_lookup` unchanged.
Tim: probably because pack/unpack code path got serialized per-group; for group_size 64 we end up with 64 pack ops vs 8 previously? Need to check packing granularity.
Cheng: I ran a micro-bench: group-size sweep 8/16/32/64. Results: p50 latency (seq8,b16) = [8: 45ms, 16: 47ms, 32: 51ms, 64: 53ms]. Memory copies scale roughly linearly with group count.
Anya: interesting — quality calibration delta negligible, but perf hit matters for low-latency targets.
Mike: workaround patch queued to reduce kernel launches by consolidating packs across groups. Patch: reduce per-group launch when kv_cache=true. @changelog: I'll add metrics.
Marisol: rolling a canary on dedicated pool with patch. If stable we'll wire batching heuristic: prefer group_size<=32 when KV-dominant.
ci-bot: regression-trigger detected: nightly/awq/group-sweep failed threshold (p50 +10%). Jira: RW-3287 created.
Tim: next steps: 1) merge consolidate-pack patch, 2) add heuristic in router to prefer smaller group_size for short seqs, 3) add KV-weighted perf test to nightly.
Anya: I'll open a follow-up thread with bisect results for calibration vs packing tradeoffs. Thanks all :thumbsup:
